title: v4.1.0 is out
message: Please update now. (1) Fixed the progress bar going past 100% and the scraper getting stuck when a race fails: that meeting is now held back, the others carry on, and it is re-scraped from the start at the end. (2) New popups and a bell icon (top right) tell you when that happens. (3) New "Race by Race" tab to download only the races you tick. (4) Exports now save to Downloads\PUNTERS\{date}\{meeting} by default. - Vidusha Mindula
